questions.stem: What is the efficiency of a device that receives 200 J of input energy and produces 150 J of useful output energy?
questions.explanation: Efficiency = useful output / total input = 150/200 = 0.75 = 75%. Efficiency can never exceed 100%.

questions.stem: Why can the efficiency of a device never be greater than 100%?

options.text: Because energy cannot be created, so output can never exceed input

questions.explanation: Due to the conservation of energy, energy cannot be created. The useful output energy can never be more than the total input energy. Some energy is always dissipated as thermal energy, so efficiency is always less than 100%.
